 Furnace Fest announces 2027 return to Sloss Furnaces
 By Joseph Ine 
 November 17, 2026
 Courtesy of Furnace Fest 
 SHARE
 Furnace Fest will return to Birmingham, Alabama, in 2027. Organizers have announced that next year’s festival will take place Oct. 9 to Oct. 10 at its longtime home, Sloss Furnaces.
 Courtesy of Furnace Fest 
 The announcement confirms the festival’s dates and location, but a lineup has yet to be revealed. Further details, including ticket information and participating artists, are expected to be announced at a later date.
 The 2027 edition will follow Furnace Fest’s 2026 event, which took place under new ownership. The festival has historically brought together artists from the hardcore, metalcore, punk, and alternative scenes at the historic Birmingham venue.
 More information about the 2027 event is expected as the festival shares further announcements.
